answer: Each agent identity must pass a memory-hard proof-of-compute: solving a nonce chain whose difficulty is quadratic in the number of identities its hardware echoes — so the k-th fake identity costs d·k²·10 GPU-seconds. At the network summit (10,000 identities) an attacker burning 1M GPU-hours at the inlet gains only ~316 sybils, making mass fabrication uneconomical.
